title: PWS obs message
description: Observation buckets published by the device on pws/{device_id}/obs (QoS 1, not retained), every 15 minutes with jitter. Each message carries one or more buckets; each bucket carries the aggregated fields of every selected station. Delivery is at least once: the server dedupes on (device_id, seq) and on (station key, bucket start). Unknown top level keys are ignored by the server, so additionalProperties is permissive here.

device_id.description: Publishing device. Must match the device_id in the topic.

seq.description: Monotonic message sequence number per device, used for dedupe and gap detection. The server requests a resync when it sees a gap. Starts at 0 or 1 at the device's choice and never reuses a value within a firmware install.

sent.description: Time the message was handed to the MQTT client, UTC. May be much later than the bucket starts when the outbox is replaying.

interval_s.description: Length of each bucket in seconds, for example 300. All buckets in a message share this interval.

buckets.description: Observation buckets in ascending start order. A replay sends at most 20 buckets per message; a message never exceeds 64 KB, so the device splits by bucket when needed.

bucket.description: Aggregates for one time bucket of interval_s seconds starting at 'start'.

start.description: Bucket start, UTC, aligned to interval_s. Dedupe key together with the station key.

stations.description: One entry per station the user selected that produced at least one packet in this bucket. Stations never selected by the user are not sent.

station.description: Aggregated readings from one station in one bucket.

n.description: Number of decoded packets from this station that went into the bucket. 0 is allowed so the server can tell 'heard nothing' from 'not selected'.

raw.description: Decoder fields with no canonical mapping, passed through unconverted so every rtl_433 decoder works on day one. Keys are the decoder's own field names. The server stores this without interpreting it.

meta.description: Site metadata the server needs to derive sea level pressure and 10 m wind. Sent with every station so a formula fix never needs a firmware update.

alt_m.description: Altitude of the pressure sensor above mean sea level in metres. Unbounded; the contract gives no range.

wind_height_m.description: Height of the anemometer above ground in metres. Unbounded; the contract gives no range.

signal.description: Radio link quality for this station as reported by the SDR driver, averaged over the bucket.

rssi_db.description: Received signal strength in dB as reported by rtl_433 (relative to full scale, so normally negative). Unbounded; the scale is driver specific.

snr_db.description: Signal to noise ratio in dB. Unbounded; the scale is driver specific.
